value.rationale: The complete quadratic Walsh chaos is the canonical permutation-invariant degree-two direction in finite Boolean-cube Banach quotient geometry. Determining its exact bounded representative among exponentially many admissible higher-order corrections is a natural exact norm problem; the median solution supplies all dimensions and a concrete extremizer. The answer exhibits an order reduction from binomial(n,2) to 1.166387...n, with an explicit Gaussian-quartile constant. These facts give nonroutine finite- and large-dimensional benchmarks; no general quadratic class is claimed.
